annotations.text:
Resolved: A (Tasks) and B (Config) both ship as views of the same app, switched from the top of the sidebar; C dropped.
Every other artboard is drawn in view A — switching to B only regroups and renames pages.
The row contract is the whole schema-driven app: 292 of 353 options render from generated data, 61 from the curated overlay. Identical in both views.
The wizard never edits hyprland.conf — it writes a Lua tree beside it, verifies over IPC, and keeps the old config as the rollback target.
